_comment: WORLD §5.1 dead-end pockets (coordinator ruling: a walled dead-end clearing of installed static walls or deadwood with an existing reward moved inside counts; a pickup grid point does not). Each pocket is a 16 x 16 m clearing walled on every side by a dead-trunk palisade with one 5 m mouth facing its nearest road. mouth_yaw_deg is the horizontal direction from the centre out through the mouth (0 = +Z, 90 = +X). The reward is an existing optional_reward_pocket pickup from the same region, moved inside.
